stories.title: Russian drones strike bus and train in southern Ukraine, killing 5
stories.summary: Russian drones hit a passenger bus and a train in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region on Wednesday, killing five people, officials said. It is the latest in Moscow's ongoing strike campaign against civilian targets.

stories.title: Kosovo ex-president Hashim Thaci sentenced to 25 years for war crimes
stories.summary: The Kosovo war crimes tribunal in The Hague found former President Hashim Thaci guilty of offences including murder, torture and illegal detention and sentenced him to 25 years in prison. The verdict closes a long-running case over the 1990s conflict.

stories.title: US confirms for the first time it has weapons deployed in Earth's orbit
stories.summary: The US military has publicly acknowledged deploying offensive weapons in Earth's orbit, the first such confirmation, drawing warnings from Russia and China about a space arms race. Analysts say it accelerates risk in an increasingly militarized orbital domain.

stories.title: Anthropic merges Claude chat and Cowork into one interface
stories.summary: Anthropic is combining its Claude chat experience with Cowork, its collaborative AI workspace product, into a single interface. The move consolidates its lineup as it prepares for an IPO.

stories.title: OpenAI weighs pre-IPO funding round at more than $1.2 trillion valuation
stories.summary: OpenAI is in early talks with investors about a new round valuing the ChatGPT maker at over $1.2 trillion, and reportedly aiming for $1.5 trillion, ahead of an IPO not expected until next year. The raise would let it push back its listing and support acquisitions.

stories.title: EU proposes under-13 ban on social media and AI chatbots in 'Kids Act'
stories.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen unveiled a proposal to ban children under 13 from social media, games and AI chatbots, and to give 13-to-15-year-olds only supervised 'mini accounts'. It targets addictive design like infinite scrolling and would apply bloc-wide if adopted.

stories.title: Deshaun Watson: 'Media thinks I'm supposed to throw for 400 yards, 5 TDs each week'
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson pushed back on expectations ahead of Sunday's game at Tampa Bay, after a rough Week 1 loss to the Jaguars. Coach Todd Monken says Watson will remain the starter against Baker Mayfield and the Buccaneers.

stories.title: Buccaneers learn Browns' QB plan: Deshaun Watson to start in Week 2
stories.summary: Cleveland coach Todd Monken said he 'anticipates' Deshaun Watson will start Sunday at Tampa Bay despite a poor opener. The road game pits Watson against Baker Mayfield in a reunion matchup.

stories.title: Browns cycle 8 roster moves as Dylan Sampson goes to IR ahead of Week 2
stories.summary: Cleveland made eight roster moves Tuesday, including placekicker Dylan Sampson to injured reserve, as it pivots from the Week 1 loss to Tampa Bay prep. Most moves were practice-squad-related.

stories.title: Ryan Day hints a Buckeye is set to take on a bigger role
stories.summary: Ryan Day hinted during his weekly remarks that an Ohio State player is poised to become a larger part of the offense. The comment comes as the Buckeyes look to regroup after the road loss to Texas.

stories.title: Julian Sayin candid on Ohio State's loss to Texas
stories.summary: Quarterback Julian Sayin made an admission about Ohio State's loss to Texas that track what fans saw on the field. The Buckeyes are preparing for Kent State on Sept. 19.

stories.title: Monaco to host its first-ever Sprint as F1 2027 calendar confirms 10 Sprints
stories.summary: Formula 1 confirmed the 2027 calendar with Monaco staging a Sprint for the first time, one of ten Sprint weekends next season. Bahrain, Australia, Japan and Abu Dhabi also become first-time Sprint hosts.

stories.title: Hamilton and Leclerc set for Ferrari Pirelli test at Imola
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc will take part in a Pirelli tyre test at Imola this week, with Ferrari also running a previous-car test there. Imola has emerged as a candidate to host the final round of the 2026 season.

stories.title: Honda promotes Yoichiro Fukao to lead F1 power unit project after Spanish GP
stories.summary: Honda promoted Yoichiro Fukao to lead its Formula 1 power unit project with Aston Martin, replacing Tetsushi Kakuda in a planned transition. The change comes as Honda works to improve under the new 2026 regulations.

stories.title: Adrian Newey inspects Alpine A526 at Spanish Grand Prix
stories.summary: Adrian Newey was on the Spanish Grand Prix grid inspecting Alpine's A526, his attention turning to the French squad. The visit adds to speculation around the design legend's next involvement.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov adds weekly Leagues system in patch 1.1.5.1
stories.summary: Battlestate Games shipped patch 1.1.5.1 adding a weekly Leagues system on top of the Lighthouse rework. A later 1.2.0.0 update, due late September or early October, targets PvE improvements.

stories.title: Dublin, Ohio man pleads guilty to sexual assault in Utah
stories.summary: A Dublin man pleaded guilty to sexual assault charges stemming from conduct in Utah, court records show. The case has drawn attention to cross-state prosecution of a central Ohio resident.

stories.title: Central Ohio cities debate Flock camera usage
stories.summary: Several central Ohio cities are weighing how to use Flock automatic license-plate-reader cameras as Columbus council reviews the program amid a planned protest. Supporters cite crime-solving; critics raise privacy concerns.

stories.title: Scattered storms and muggy heat arrive in central Ohio
stories.summary: Hot and humid conditions with scattered rain and storms are expected across Columbus on Wednesday and Thursday, with a few gusty cells possible. Drier weather and cooler temperatures are expected over the weekend.
